description: This file defines the 'Relationship' class, which manages relationship metadata for the SuiteCRM application, including methods for querying, caching, and analyzing relationships between modules.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: A model class representing a relationship between modules in SuiteCRM, providing methods for relationship management and metadata handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the Relationship object.

methods.name: is_self_referencing
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is self-referencing by comparing lhs and rhs table and key names.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a relationship with the given name exists in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks a relationship as deleted in the database.

methods.name: get_other_module
methods.description: Returns the module name on the other side of a specified relationship.

methods.name: retrieve_by_sides
methods.description: Retrieves relationship metadata based on lhs and rhs module names.

methods.name: retrieve_by_modules
methods.description: Retrieves a relationship name based on module pairs and optional type filtering.

methods.name: retrieve_by_name
methods.description: Loads relationship metadata into the object based on relationship name.

methods.name: load_relationship_meta
methods.description: Loads relationship metadata cache from disk into global variables.

methods.name: build_relationship_cache
methods.description: Builds and caches all relationship metadata from the database.

methods.name: cache_file_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where relationship cache files are stored.

methods.name: cache_file_name_only
methods.description: Returns the filename for the relationship cache file.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes the cached relationship metadata file.

methods.name: trace_relationship_module
methods.description: Follows the relationship chain from a base module to another related module.
